layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Abstract—In the realm of artificial intelligence, the emergence

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of foundation models, backed by high computing capabilities and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: extensive data, has been revolutionary. A segment anything model

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (SAM), built on the vision transformer (ViT) model with millions

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of parameters and trained on its corresponding large-scale dataset

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SA-1B, excels in various segmentation scenarios relying on its

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: significance of semantic information and generalization ability.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Such achievement of visual foundation model stimulates contin-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: uous researches on specific downstream tasks in computer vision.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The classwise-SAM-adapter (CWSAM) is designed to adapt the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: high-performing SAM for landcover classification on space-borne

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images. The proposed CWSAM

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: freezes most of SAM's parameters and incorporates lightweight

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adapters for parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and a classwise mask

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: decoder is designed to achieve semantic segmentation task. This

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adapt-tuning method allows for efficient landcover classification of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SAR images, balancing the accuracy with computational demand.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In addition, the task-specific input module injects low-frequency

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: information of SAR images by MLP-based layers to improve

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the model performance. Compared to conventional state-of-the-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: art semantic segmentation algorithms by extensive experiments,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: CWSAM showcases enhanced performance with fewer computing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: resources, highlighting the potential of leveraging foundational

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: models such as SAM for specific downstream tasks in the SAR

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: domain.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to the release of segment anything model (SAM) [1], the progres-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sions of foundation models in computer vision and the involved

layout_dets.text: researches are booming. This brings available future of uniform

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: large model in computer vision because of its zero-shot ability on

layout_dets.text: natural scene segmentation task. SAM has impressive segmenta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion performance in extensive application fields benefiting from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: its elaborate architectures and large-scale training dataset named

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SA-1B, which contains billions of segmentation annotations.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Although the great generalization and zero-shot ability on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: most of scenes show prominent advantages of SAM as a visual

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: foundation model, the complicated requirements of downstream

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tasks and multiple application fields raise more complex require-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ments and further optimizations of SAM. Especially for syn-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: thetic aperture radar (SAR) images [2], [3], the unique imaging

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mechanism of electromagnetic wave on SAR induces distinctive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: image characteristics that are inexperienced and indecipherable

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for SAM. Several recent works based on deep learning aim to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: improve traditional model performance on SAR image segmen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation tasks. FFSSNet [4]is designed to achieve feature fusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from different scales of SAR images. LGMFNet [5] provides

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a dual encoder-decoder architecture for the SAR building seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation task. Marine aquaculture zone extraction algorithm

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on dual-polarimetric SAR Images is explored by MAZ-Net [6]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: However, such diverse resolutions and different polarization

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: methods of SAR images tend to confuse SAM for pixel-level

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation because the pretrained data of SA-1B dataset is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: unable to cover such fine-grained situations on SAR image

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation tasks. The interference characteristics of SAR

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: images from electromagnetic wave imaging mechanisms and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: some low signal-to-noise-ratio (SNR) scenarios are distinct from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: natural scenes and too unique to be considered when training

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: natural vision foundation models. This deteriorates the effec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tiveness and reliability of SAM on SAR images segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: task as a consequence [7]. On the other hand, due to the scarce

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: opportunity and high cost of accessing SAR images, it is difficult

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to construct an SAR foundation model from scratch with limited

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SAR image data resources. Utilizing SAM for the SAR image

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: interpretation presents a possibility worth exploring. However,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: it comes with challenges that we summarize to the following

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: two main issues.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1) SAM is hardly able to segment the SAR images for reason-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: able accuracy even though it has good generalization ca-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pability on natural images including optical aerial images

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: as shown in Fig. 1(a). Considering the electromagnetic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: wave imaging mechanism of signal echo on SAR, the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: appearances of SAR images are very different with natural

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scene images. To be specific, SAR images exhibit coherent

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: speckle noise due to wave physics, side lobes, and the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: complex scattering characteristics that can introduce false

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: alarms, and layover and shadowing effects in regions with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: steep terrain or tall structures. Specific situations of SAR

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: images including multiple polarization properties and low

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SNR imaging circumstances are rarely involved in SAM.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2) The category-agnostic property of SAM hinders its appli-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cation on diverse visual downstream tasks. For semantic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation and landcover classification tasks on SAR

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: images, each pixel needs a predicted category while SAM

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: only generates several binary mask lack of classwise infor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mation under the guidance of prompt input. The segment

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: results of SAR images from SAM represent almost no

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: meaningful semantic information as shown in Fig. 1(b)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: because pixels in the same category are not classified into

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the same category. In addition, landcover classification

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: task demand the model to output a multiclass predicted

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mask for each image while the quantity of output masks

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by SAM is variable.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Therefore, we propose a method named classwise-SAM-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adapter (CWSAM) to achieve reasonable performance on pixel-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: level SAR landcover classification task by leveraging founda-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion model SAM and adding a classwise light-weighted mask

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: decoder. A well-designed adapter fine-tuning mechanism is uti-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lized. Freezing most parameters of the heavy vision transformer

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (ViT) [8] image encoder of SAM and inserting a small number

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of trainable parameters by adapters, CWSAM shifts the natural

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scene domain of SAM to SAR domain, and explores the poten-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tial application of large model in SAR downstream tasks such

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: as landcover classification. Since only limited parameters are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trainable with gradient in the model weight, CWSAM demands

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: low computing resources and makes training process efficient.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We construct CWSAM as a preliminary attempt of visual

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: foundation model application in SAR images and believe that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: such effective methods with viable computing cost will bring

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: good future on the development of foundation model to SAR

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: intelligent interpretation. Extensive experiments illustrate that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the efficiency and reliability of the proposed method on both

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation performance and training process. CWSAM out-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: performs multiple state-of-the-art semantic segmentation al-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: gorithms with fewer trainable parameters and less memory

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: consumption. To our best knowledge, it is the first time that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SAM is introduced for parameter-efficient fine-tuning on SAR

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: domain to realize semantic segmentation downstream task with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: category-aware ability.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In summary, the contributions of this article can be summa-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rized as follows.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1) The proposed CWSAM introduces an end-to-end archi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tecture with light-weighted adapters inserted in the image

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: encoder of SAM for efficient parameter fine-tuning on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: large models. The method transfers the natural scene do-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: main of SAM to the SAR domain. By leveraging the visual

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: foundation model, it achieves a reliable performance on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: landcover classification tasks using SAR images.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2) A classwise mask decoder of CWSAM is designed to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: expand classwise attribute to original category-agnostic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SAM model for fine-grained semantic segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: downstream task. For SAR images, the light-weight class-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: wise upscaling convolution layer in the classwise mask de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: coder is utilized to identify multiple landcover categories

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on pixel level.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3) The task-specific input module of SAR image low-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: frequency information is conducted to provide sufficient

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: semantic information of landcover characteristics through

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2-D image fast Fourier transform in the end-to-end archi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tecture automatically for enhancing segmentation perfor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mance.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that CWSAM sur-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: passes multiple existing semantic segmentation algorithms with-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: out the high requirements of computing costs. Even though

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: meeting the characteristic difference between SAR and natural

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: images of SAM, the proposed method achieves to employ the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: advantages of foundation model to improve the segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: performance on SAR images.

layout_dets.text: II. RELATED WORKS

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: A. Segment Anything Model

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SAM is released by Meta AI Research in the segment anything

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (SA) project for image segmentation and shows impressive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: zero-shot performance and powerful generalization on multi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ple application scenes [9]. SAM conducts a ViT-based image

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: encoder, a light-weighted mask decoder, and a flexible prompt

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: encoder allowing inputs of points, bounding boxes, masks, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: texts. Inspired by the booming large language model (LLM) in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: NLP, the image encoder of SAM adopts the basic architecture of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ViT and has three different sizes of models, including ViT-Base,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ViT-Huge, and ViT-Large. MAE [10] method is explored to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pretrain the ViT that can process high resolution input images.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SAM has powerful zero-shot abilities by prompt engineering

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that contains two types of prompts: sparse prompt (points, boxes,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and text) and dense prompt (mask). Positional encoding [11]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is responsible for extracting prompt embeddings of points and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: boxes, and CLIP [12] is responsible for text prompts. Dense

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: prompts are embedded by the convolution module and summed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: elementwise to fuse with image embedding. Multiple prompt

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: methods enable the users to concentrate on various scenes and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: objects, and bring strong application flexibility relying on SAM

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: zero-shot advantages. In addition, the mask decoder provides

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: three output masks of diverse scopes for per image input to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: address the issue of ambiguous prompt.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: B. Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of SAM

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Leveraging the data engine and SA-1B dataset with billions of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: masks, SAM is regarded as a foundation model of segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in computer vision and simulates diverse exploration algorithms

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on utilizing SAM for downstream tasks on various application

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fields. The authors in [13], [14], and [15] explore the potential

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of SAM on medical image analysis, the authors in [16] and [17]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: focus on camouflaged object detection, and Ahmadi et al. [18]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: focus on infrastructure detection. Mirror and transparent objects

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: detection task based on SAM is also involved in [19].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Furthermore, for aerial images, several researches [20], [21]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: robe the generalization of SAM under typical gap between

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: natural scenes of SAM and remote sensing. Wang et al. [22]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: develop SAM as an efficient annotation system to produce the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: large-scale remote sensing segmentation dataset called SAMRS.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The authors in [23] and [24] conduct prompt engineering to opti-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mize SAM for downstream segmentation task on remote sensing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: images. RingMo [25]leverages generative self-supervised learn-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing to build a foundation model for remote sensing, and then, it

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is combined with SAM to achieve a foundation model for mul-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: timodal remote-sensing image segmentation called RingMo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SAM [26]. SCD-SAM [27] combines MobileSAM and CNN

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to extract progressive semantic change features for remote sens-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing images through adapter-based PEFT technology. Osco [28]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: explores the potential of SAM for remote sensing applications

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: including zero shot and one shot problems. RSAM-Seg [29]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: integrates prior knowledge into SAM and utilizes adapter fine-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tuning for remote sensing image semantic segmentation. Road-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SAM [30] leverages SAM's powerful generalization for high

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: resolution road extraction in optical remote sensing images.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Considering full fine-tuning a large model is difficult due to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the high demand of computing resources and available data,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: most of these SAM fine-tuning researches follow the main-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stream parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods of transformer

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: architecture inspired by LLMs and NLP technologies, including

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adding additional parameters, selecting a part of parameters

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to update, and introducing reparametrization. The methods of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adding additional parameters can be roughly divided into two

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: types: inserting extra adapter modules [31] and soft prompts

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fine-tuning [32], [33].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: C. Semantic Segmentation and SAR Landcover Classification

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Semantic segmentation plays an essential role on computer vi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sion and has made great achievements on proposing a variety of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: deep learning-based algorithms. Regarded as an extension task

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from image classification to pixel-level image segmentation,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: semantic segmentation starts from a fundamental architecture

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of fully convolutional networks named FCN [34] and emerges

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: manifold model designs and different structures of mask de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: coders to improve the segmentation performance. Subsequently,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: various encoder-decoder architectures [35], [36] are optimized

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with attention mechanisms [37], [38], proper receptive filed [39],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [40], high-resolution feature pyramid [41], [42], dilated convo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lutions [43], [44], and so on. Transformer-based algorithms [45],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [46] conduct great performance on semantic segmentation task.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The requirements of pixel-level semantic segmentation ap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plications on SAR images tend to be urgent with the develop-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ment of high-resolution SAR technologies [47], [48]. Several

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: modified FCNs network are proposed for wetland semantic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation task on SAR images [49] and PolSAR image

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: semantic segmentation task [50] through transfer learning. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: authors in [51], [52], and [53] utilize the FCNs networks as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: baseline and focus on the single category on segmentation tasks

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of SAR images, such as oil spill, road, and building. The authors

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in [54] and [55] explored the landcover semantic segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tasks containing multiple categories on GF-3 SAR images via

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: an encoder-decoder structure and a transformer architecture.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: MCANet [56] proposed a multimodal-cross-attention network

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to achieve land use classification task by fusing the feature

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: map of both optical and SAR images, as well as CFNet [57].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SCNN [58] utilizes the statistical convolutional neural network

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to encode and analyze the statistical properties of the SAR image

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for landcover classification on the TerraSAR-X data.

layout_dets.text: B. Classwise Mask Decoder and Loss Function

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To represent the multiple categories of every pixels, a class-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: wise mask decoder is built on the original architecture of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mask decoder in SAM [1] and consists of a category pre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: diction head to achieve landcover classification task. In the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: classwise mask decoder of the proposed CWSAM algorithm,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the dynamic mask prediction head is ignored so that only one

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1) Architecture: The framework of the classwise mask en-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: coder is explained in Fig. 4. At the beginning, two two-way trans-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: former blocks are explored to extract features of all embeddings,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: attention mechanisms are employed, such as self-attention for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: prompt embedding and cross-attention between image embed-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ding and prompt embedding with two directions (image-to-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: prompt embedding and prompt-to-image embedding). An up-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scaling convolution block of the SAM mask decoder prepares

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the final output binary mask.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: However, with binary mask results, the original design of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mask decoder of SAM is unable to figure out classification

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on pixel level for semantic segmentation task. Therefore, a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: classwise light-weighted convolution module named classwise

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: upscaling convolution is implemented for multiclasses mask

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: prediction by outputting the channel dimension corresponding

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to the number of categories to generate classwise segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: masks. After the upscaling output convolution block of the SAM

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mask decoder, the classwise upscaling convolution module is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a ReLU activation layer, and a convolution block to enlarge

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: semantic feature to generate final mask prediction of N classes

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: channels for separate category.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.text: of the filtering range must be tailored to the characteristics of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the downstream task. In the context of multiclass landcover

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: classification tasks for SAR images, low-frequency information

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: not only preserves the imaging characteristics of SAR landcover

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: reflections but also facilitates denoising, such as weakening

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: speckle noise and other strong interferences. This enhances the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: feature extraction capabilities of SAR images. Conversely, high-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: frequency information, which retains only the discrete edge de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tails of SAR images, fails to provide effective semantic features

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for multiclass semantic segmentation tasks. However, it may

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: be beneficial for providing critical edge details in single-class

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation tasks for optical images.

layout_dets.text: C. Implementation Details

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Our experiments of the proposed method are conducted on the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: architecture of SAM ViT-Base backbone and compared with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: multiple the state-of-the-art algorithms in semantic segmenta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion task under the unified training configuration and settings

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: using Pytorch.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1) Configurations: Two Nvidia RTX 3090 GPUs are em-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ployed to train the model for total 120 epochs, and only

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: one for inference process. All the experiments adopt the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: AdamW optimizer and cosine annealing learning rate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: strategy with the initial learning rate of 0.0002. All the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: images have the resolution of 1024× 1024 with the batch

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: size of 1 in the training process to fully make use of com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: puting resources. The processing time of model inference

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: process for the proposed method is 1.22 s per image with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2) Model architecture: Based on the ViT-Base, which is the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: smallest model of SAM, the main feature dimensions of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the model maintain unchanged, including SAM image en-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: coder, prompt encoder, and most part of the mask decoder.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In the ViT-based image encoder, the first module is a patch

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: embedding block with the patch size of 16 and 14× 14 win-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dowed attention. Subsequently, 12 number of transformer

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: blocks with embedding dimension size of 768 extract the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: image features of the constant dimensions as 64× 64× 768.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Four equally spaced global attention blocks are set on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: layers 2, 5, 8, and 11 on the ViT image encoder, and a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: final convolution block generates the image embeddings

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with 256 output channels.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Besides, the feature dimension of all adapters in the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: image encoder is 768, which is same as embedding dimen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sion of ViT blocks, and the hidden dimension of adapters

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is one quarter of embedding dimension. For task-specific

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: input, the channel dimension is downscaled to 24 by a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fully connected layer for light-weighted computing pro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cess, and maintains invariant at individual light-weighted

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: MLP blocks. A shared MLP block increase the channel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dimension from 24 to the embedding dimension size of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 768 in order to finish the feature fusion through simple

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matrix summation with ViT blocks.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: For the classwise mask decoder with feature enhance

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: module, the transformer dimension is 256 and the SAM

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: output upscaling block dimensions are 256 for input, 64

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for hidden layer, and 32 for output features. After feature

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: enhanced concatenation, the classwise upscaling block

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: takes the input feature of 64 channels, and conduct the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: transposed convolution module of output dimension of 64,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: kernel size of 2, and stride of 2, to upscale the feature reso-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lution from 64 × 64 to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: . Following a normalize

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: layer and activation layer, a convolution block outputs the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: classwise upscaled embedding of 32×number of classes

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: channels, which is reshaped to size of (1 ×32×number of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: classes×256×256) for each ambiguous mask per batch

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: size. Finally, four ambiguity-aware predicted masks are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: derived from a spatially pointwise product between the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: upscale classwise image embedding and MLP outputs

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: whose size are 4×(1,32).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3) Weighted losses: When the data distribution in landcover

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: classification dataset of SAR images is unbalanced, some

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: categories that are easy to be recognized or have sufficient

layout_dets.text: samples will dominate the model iteration and conver-

layout_dets.text: gence during the training process. Therefore, the weighted

layout_dets.text: cross entropy losses are employed in our experiments

layout_dets.text: dataset, the weights of building, vegetation, water, road,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and background are 1.5, 1, 0.5, 1.9, and 0.1, respectively,

layout_dets.text: road, industry, residence, vegetation, paddy field, planting

layout_dets.text: 0.5, 1.5, 1.7, 1.4, and 0.9, respectively. All of these ten

layout_dets.text: landcover categories are evaluated in experiments, and

layout_dets.text: the data distributions of the training and test scenes are

layout_dets.text: For parameter-efficient fine-tuning task, there is a tradeoff

layout_dets.text: between the quantity of learnable parameters and model per-

layout_dets.text: formance. Some uncertainty influences still exist depending on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: specific tasks and datasets. For relatively easy tasks or with a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: small number of training samples, a small number of learnable

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: parameters can ensure reliable performance. Increasing the num-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ber of tuning parameters does not enhance accuracy and can lead

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to overfitting, where the model excels on training data but fails

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on new or test data. Overfitting indicates that the model may be

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: memorizing the training data rather than generalizing from it.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: On the other hand, increasing the number of parameters

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: can improve the model's capacity to fit complex data. It can

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: help the model capture intricate patterns and relationships. For
